title: Post Processor Generator — Gap Remediation + Web App Page + Full Wiring

mcp_utilization_protocol.feature_cascade: Read SESSION_ARTIFACTS.json at start -> write via PostCompact hook at end

hooks: review-gate.sh: BLOCKS edits after 3 engine changes without /prism-review
PostToolUse stub detector: BLOCKS stub returns in engines
PostToolUse test quality: BLOCKS || true and bare .includes() in tests

brief.goal: Fix all 20-agent scrutiny findings, build full PPG web page following calculator design, wire 920 machines + 6353 materials + 75K tools + 2365 holders to page. User flow: machine → controller → features → CAM → tools → generate post + G-code.

phases.title: Critical Bug Fixes — 20-Agent Scrutiny Remediation
phases.intent: Fix all CRITICAL and HIGH findings from the 20-agent review. Machine ID mismatch (C1), property reduction (C2), Hurco VM30i specs (H1), 4140 Vc (H2), TIR usage (H3), prove-out in CPS (H4), CORS fix (H6), default aggressiveness (H7).

phases.title: PPG Page Architecture — Layout + Machine Selector + Controller
phases.intent: Build the new PPG page shell following CalculatorPage patterns. Machine search wired to 920-machine database. Controller auto-populated. Machine features auto-detected with toggles.

phases.title: Material + Tooling + Holder Wiring
phases.intent: Wire material search (6353 materials), tool selection (75K tools), holder selection (2365 holders) to the PPG page with search, filter, and physics auto-calculation.

phases.title: CAM Package + Post Generation + G-Code Preview
phases.intent: CAM package selector (Fusion/Mastercam/hyperMILL/etc), CPS generation pipeline, G-code preview with physics annotations, download + deploy flow.

phases.title: Medium Findings + Data Fixes + Polish
phases.intent: Fix all MEDIUM findings: Macor kc1.1, Mo kc1.1, LB3000 RPM, DNC mode, chip thinning formula, thin-wall derating, MAZATROL detection, AS9100 traceability.

phases.title: Integration Testing + Final Scrutiny
phases.intent: Full E2E testing of the complete PPG page flow. Re-run 20-agent scrutiny. All findings resolved. Omega 1.0.

sessions.title: Critical Fix — Machine ID Mismatch + Property Reduction
sessions.intent: Fix the #1 bug: machine dropdown IDs don't match database keys. Reduce 601 properties to manageable set. Fix Hurco VM30i specs.
sessions.exit_gate: All machine dropdown selections resolve to correct database entries. Properties reduced to <=200. VM30i specs correct. npx vitest run passes.

sessions.title: Critical Fix — Physics + Safety + Defaults
sessions.intent: Fix 4140 Vc to 170-180, wire TIR into speed calc, add prove-out to CPS fallback, fix default aggressiveness to 'balanced', fix CORS headers.
sessions.exit_gate: 4140 rec=175. TIR used in speed calc. Prove-out in CPS standalone. Default aggressiveness=balanced. CORS headers on /api. All tests pass.

sessions.title: PPG Page Shell — Layout + Routing + Hero
sessions.intent: Create PostProcessorPage.tsx (new page, replacing/extending existing PPG page). Route at /ppg. WorkspacePrimitives layout. 5-step wizard flow: Machine → Material → Tools → CAM → Generate.
sessions.exit_gate: Page renders at /ppg. 5-step wizard navigation works. WorkspacePrimitives used throughout. Dark theme matches calculator.

sessions.title: Machine Selector — Search + Controller + Features
sessions.intent: Wire machine search to 920-machine database via /api/v1/data/machine_search. Auto-populate controller from machine. Auto-detect machine features (TSC, probing, 4th/5th axis, rigid tapping, chip conveyor). User can toggle features on/off.
sessions.exit_gate: Machine search returns results from 920-machine DB. Controller auto-fills. Features auto-populate with toggles. All wired to state.

sessions.title: Material Selector — Search + Physics Display
sessions.intent: Wire material search to 6353-material database. Show Kienzle constants, Taylor tool life, recommended speeds. Group by ISO category with filter.
sessions.exit_gate: Material search returns from full DB. Kienzle/Taylor displayed. ISO group filter works. Physics auto-calculated on selection.

sessions.title: Tool + Holder Selection — Per-Operation Config
sessions.intent: Wire tool search to 75K-tool database. Wire holder search to 2365-holder database. Per-tool card with: type, diameter, flutes, material, coating, holder, insert nose radius. Physics auto-updates on each change.
sessions.exit_gate: Tool search works. Holder search works. Per-tool cards with all fields. S/F auto-recalculates. Holder TIR/stiffness shown.

sessions.title: CAM Package Selector + Post Generation Pipeline
sessions.intent: CAM package dropdown (Fusion 360, Mastercam, hyperMILL, SolidCAM, NX, CATIA, Esprit, GibbsCAM). Each package maps to post template. Generate button calls pipeline. CPS file generated with all user selections embedded.
sessions.exit_gate: 8 CAM packages selectable. Post generation produces valid CPS. Machine/material/tool selections embedded in generated CPS. Download button works.

sessions.title: G-Code Preview + Comparison + Prove-Out Controls
sessions.intent: G-code preview panel with syntax highlighting. Upload existing program → optimize → side-by-side diff. Prove-out controls (enable/disable, feed%, speed%). Physics annotations per changed line.
sessions.exit_gate: G-code preview renders. Upload + optimize works. Diff view shows changes. Prove-out toggle functional. Physics reasons displayed.

sessions.title: Medium Findings — Physics Data Fixes
sessions.intent: Fix: Macor kc1.1 to 950, Mo kc1.1 to 1550, LB3000 RPM to 5000. Improve chip thinning formula with full (D-ae) term. Add thin-wall derating. Fix MAZATROL detection (require 2+ markers). Add version stamp to G-code header.
sessions.exit_gate: All material constants corrected. Chip thinning uses full formula. Thin-wall mode available. MAZATROL needs 2+ markers. Version in header. Tests pass.

sessions.title: Medium Findings — CPS Polish + Missing Features
sessions.intent: Add DNC/drip-feed awareness for large programs. Fix safe-start block order (G90 first). Add G54.1 P1-P48 extended work offsets. Add M88 through-spindle coolant code. Add Hurco VMX30U to database.
sessions.exit_gate: DNC warning on large programs. Safe start G90 first. Extended offsets supported. M88 TSC correct. VMX30U in DB. Tests pass.

sessions.title: Integration Testing — Full Page E2E
sessions.intent: Full E2E tests: machine search → controller auto-fill → features → material → tools → CAM → generate → preview → download. Test all 8 CAM packages. Test offline fallback. Test 3 machine brands end-to-end.
sessions.exit_gate: 15+ E2E tests pass. All 8 CAM packages generate valid output. Offline mode works. Machine auto-fill verified for Haas/Hurco/DMG.

sessions.title: Final Scrutiny — Re-run 20 Agents + Ship
sessions.intent: Re-run all 20 scrutiny agents. All CRITICAL/HIGH findings resolved. All MEDIUM findings resolved. Deploy add-in + CPS to desktop. Omega 1.0.
sessions.exit_gate: 20-agent scrutiny: 0 CRITICAL, 0 HIGH, <=3 MINOR. All tests pass. CPS on desktop. Add-in installable. Omega >= 1.0.

U-PH01.title: Fix machine dropdown-to-database ID mismatch
U-PH01.description: Synchronize ALL machine enum IDs with machineDatabase keys. The enum uses haas_vf_1 but DB uses haas_vf1, enum uses dn_solutions_* but DB uses doosan_*. Fix ONE direction (standardize enum IDs to match DB keys). Verify all 162 machines resolve.
abort_criteria: Any machine dropdown selection still silently fails
U-PH01.exit_gate: All 162 machine dropdown selections resolve to a database entry. No undefined returns from machineDatabase lookup. Verified by grep.

U-PH02.title: Reduce CPS properties from 601 to <=200
U-PH02.description: Reduce 24 tool pockets to 10 max. Remove unused properties. Group remaining into logical sections. Target: 10 pockets × 12 essential fields = 120 pocket props + 50 machine/material/global = ~170 total.
abort_criteria: Any referenced property removed without updating consumers
U-PH02.exit_gate: Property count <= 200. All referenced properties still exist. Post generates valid G-code. Tests pass.

U-PH03.title: Fix Hurco VM30i specs — torque, taper, power, defaults
U-PH03.description: VM30i: maxRpm=10000 (correct), powerHp=25 (not 30), torqueFtLb=105 (not 79), taper=cat40 (not big_plus_40). Fix machineDatabase entry. Fix longDescription. Fix default spindle interface property. Set default aggressiveness to 'balanced' (not 'max_mrr').
abort_criteria: Specs don't match Hurco published data
U-PH03.exit_gate: VM30i: 10K RPM, 25 HP, 105 ft-lb, CAT40. Default aggressiveness=balanced. Verified by reading machineDatabase entry.

U-PH04.title: Raise 4140 annealed Vc from 140 to 175 m/min
U-PH04.description: Update P_4140_ANN speed rec from 140 to 175, min from 90 to 100, max from 195 to 240. Also check P_4140_QT and adjust proportionally. These represent TiAlN-coated carbide baseline per Sandvik catalog.
U-PH04.exit_gate: P_4140_ANN rec=175. Verified against Sandvik CoroMill Plura catalog.

U-PH05.title: Wire TIR into speed calculation, stiffness into feed
U-PH05.description: In calculateSpeed: change holderFactor to use holderData.tir (lower TIR = higher speed). In calculateFeedRate: keep using holderData.stiffness. Formula: speedFactor = 1.0 - (tir * 500) clamped [0.85, 1.0]. feedFactor = 0.85 + (stiffness * 0.15) as today.
abort_criteria: Drill chuck gets higher speed than shrink fit
U-PH05.exit_gate: Shrink fit (TIR=0.0001) speed factor > drill chuck (TIR=0.001). Feed factor unchanged. Tests pass.

U-PH06.title: Add prove-out mode to CPS standalone (no server needed)
U-PH06.description: Add prismProveOut boolean property (default: true), prismProveOutFeedPct (default: 50), prismProveOutSpeedPct (default: 80). In onSection, if prove-out enabled, multiply S by speedPct/100 and F by feedPct/100 AFTER physics optimization. Add header comment warning.
U-PH06.exit_gate: Prove-out ON by default. 50% feed, 80% speed. Header says PROVE-OUT. Derated values clamped to machine limits.

U-PH07.title: Fix CORS headers on Express server for add-in panel
U-PH07.description: In routes/index.ts, ensure CORS middleware sends Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * for localhost requests. Verify panel.html fetch() calls work in Fusion's CEF browser. Add error feedback when search fails.
U-PH07.exit_gate: fetch('http://localhost:18361/api/cam') from file:// origin succeeds with CORS. Panel search shows results.

U-PH08.title: Create PPG page shell with 5-step wizard
U-PH08.description: New component or refactor PostProcessorGeneratorPage.tsx. 5-step wizard: 1.Machine 2.Material 3.Tools 4.CAM 5.Generate. Use WorkspacePrimitives (WorkspaceHero, PanelCard, TabButton, ActionButton, Field, Input, Select, StatusPill). Dark theme. Step indicator at top.
U-PH08.exit_gate: 5-step wizard renders at /ppg. Each step shows/hides content. Navigation works. Matches calculator dark theme.

U-PH09.title: Wire page routing and lazy loading
U-PH09.description: Ensure /ppg route in App.tsx uses lazyNamed pattern. Add breadcrumbs. Connect to sidebar navigation.
U-PH09.exit_gate: /ppg loads PPG page. Breadcrumbs show. Sidebar link works.

U-PH10.title: Build WorkspaceHero and SummaryTiles for PPG
U-PH10.description: Hero section: 'Post Processor Generator' title, subtitle 'Physics-optimized G-code for any CNC machine'. 4 SummaryTiles: Machine (selected or 'None'), Material, Tools (count), Status (ready/configuring).
U-PH10.exit_gate: Hero renders. 4 tiles update reactively. Layout responsive.

U-PH11.title: Build MachineSearchPanel component
U-PH11.description: Searchable input calling /api/v1/data/machine_search. Debounced (300ms). Results show: brand, model, RPM, HP, torque, taper, rigidity. Click selects. Selected machine card shows full specs. Uses PanelCard wrapper.
U-PH11.exit_gate: Type 'Haas VF' → see VF-1/2/2SS/3/4/5. Click VF-2 → specs fill. Card shows RPM/HP/torque/taper.

U-PH12.title: Auto-populate controller from machine selection
U-PH12.description: When machine selected, read controller field from machine profile (e.g., Haas → 'Haas NGC', DMG → 'Siemens 840D', Mazak → 'MAZATROL SmoothAi'). Controller dropdown auto-fills but user can override. Controller affects post output dialect.
U-PH12.exit_gate: Select Haas VF-2 → controller shows 'Haas NGC'. Select DMG DMU 50 → controller shows 'Siemens 840D'. User can override.

U-PH13.title: Build FeatureAutoDetectPanel component
U-PH13.description: Machine features auto-detected from machine profile and controller: TSC (bool+PSI), probing (bool), 4th axis (bool), 5th axis (bool), rigid tapping (bool), chip conveyor (bool), pallet changer (bool), bar feeder (bool). User toggles to enable/disable. Features affect post output (M-codes, cycles).
U-PH13.exit_gate: Haas VF-2 → TSC=off, probing=off, 4th=off, rigid_tap=on. DMG DMU 50 → TSC=on(1000psi), probing=on, 5th=on. User toggles work.

U-PH14.title: Build machine feature database (if gaps exist)
U-PH14.description: Check if MachineRegistry has feature flags per machine. If not, build a feature inference engine: TSC from coolantPsi>0, 5-axis from simultaneous_axes>=5, probing from controller capability, rigid tapping from controller. Store inferred features.
U-PH14.exit_gate: 920 machines have inferred feature flags. Spot-check 10 machines matches reality.

U-PH15.title: Build MaterialSearchPanel component
U-PH15.description: Searchable input calling /api/v1/data/material_search. Results show: name, ISO group, hardness, kc1.1, rec Vc. ISO group filter tabs (P/M/K/N/S/H/X). Selected material card shows full Kienzle/Taylor/thermal data.
U-PH15.exit_gate: Type '4140' → see annealed/QT variants. Click → shows kc1.1=1980, mc=0.25, Vc=175. ISO tabs filter correctly.

U-PH16.title: Wire material selection to physics preview
U-PH16.description: When material + machine + tool are all selected, show real-time physics preview: recommended RPM, feed, SFM, IPT, force (N), power (kW), tool life estimate. Uses SpeedFeedOrchestrator via /api/v1/speed-feed/orchestrate.
U-PH16.exit_gate: Select Haas VF-2 + 4140 + 12mm endmill → RPM/feed/force displayed. Change material to 6061 → values update instantly.

U-PH17.title: Add offline material fallback (top 200 embedded)
U-PH17.description: Embed top 200 materials in the frontend for offline use. If server unreachable, search falls back to embedded data. Show 'offline mode' indicator.
abort_criteria: Fallback data doesn't match server data
U-PH17.exit_gate: Disconnect server → material search still works with 200 materials. 'Offline' badge shown.

U-PH18.title: Build ToolConfigCard component
U-PH18.description: Per-tool card: tool type (endmill/drill/tap/face mill/etc), diameter, flutes, material, coating, insert nose radius (free-form number). Searchable tool lookup from 75K-tool database. Auto-fills fields from catalog match.
U-PH18.exit_gate: Search 'Sandvik CoroMill' → results. Select → diameter/flutes/coating auto-fill. Manual override works.

U-PH19.title: Build HolderSelectorPanel component
U-PH19.description: Per-tool holder selection. Search 2365 holders by brand/type. Show TIR, stiffness, max RPM, balance grade. Selected holder affects physics calculation (speed derating from TIR, feed from stiffness).
U-PH19.exit_gate: Search 'Haimer shrink' → holders listed. TIR=0.00008, stiffness=1.00 shown. Selection updates physics.

U-PH20.title: Wire tool + holder to real-time S/F calculation
U-PH20.description: When tool + holder + material + machine all set, show per-tool S/F card with: RPM, feed (mm/min), SFM, IPT, chip load (fz), force, power, tool life. Update on any input change.
U-PH20.exit_gate: Full chain: machine+material+tool+holder → S/F displayed. Change holder from ER to shrink → speed increases.

U-PH21.title: Multi-tool support — add/remove tools dynamically
U-PH21.description: User can add multiple tool cards (T1-T10). Each has independent tool/holder/physics. Add button, remove button, reorder. State managed as array of tool configs.
U-PH21.exit_gate: Add 5 tools. Each has independent S/F. Remove T3 → T4/T5 renumber. State persists.

U-PH22.title: Build CAMPackageSelector component
U-PH22.description: Dropdown or card grid: Fusion 360, Mastercam, hyperMILL, SolidCAM, NX, CATIA, Esprit, GibbsCAM. Each maps to a post template configuration (output format, specific M-codes, cycle syntax). Show CAM-specific notes.
U-PH22.exit_gate: 8 CAM packages selectable. Each shows brief description. Selection stored in state.

U-PH23.title: Wire post generation pipeline to page
U-PH23.description: Generate button calls /api/ppg/generate-post with: machine specs, controller, features, material, tools, CAM package. Returns generated CPS file content. Show generation progress. Handle errors.
U-PH23.exit_gate: Click Generate → CPS file produced. Contains correct machine limits, material data, tool configs. Download button works.

U-PH24.title: Embed user selections into generated CPS
U-PH24.description: Generated CPS should have: machineDatabase entry for selected machine pre-filled, materialDatabase entries for selected materials, per-tool properties pre-configured, prove-out defaults, correct controller dialect. User shouldn't need to re-enter anything in Fusion.
U-PH24.exit_gate: Generated CPS for Haas VF-2 + 4140 steel: machineDatabase has VF-2 entry, materialSpecific defaults to P_4140_ANN, T1 properties match user input.

U-PH25.title: Wire program optimization pipeline to page
U-PH25.description: Upload existing NC program → pipeline optimizes with selected machine/material/tools → show optimized output + comparison report. Uses /api/ppg/pipeline endpoint.
U-PH25.exit_gate: Upload Haas program → optimized output shown. Comparison report with physics reasons. Download optimized version.

U-PH26.title: Build G-code preview panel with syntax highlighting
U-PH26.description: G-code preview with line numbers, syntax highlighting (G/M codes colored, comments dimmed, S/F values highlighted). Scrollable. Copy to clipboard. Shows PRISM physics comments inline.
U-PH26.exit_gate: Preview renders 1000+ lines without lag. G-codes green, M-codes blue, comments gray. Copy works.

U-PH27.title: Build side-by-side diff view for program comparison
U-PH27.description: Two-column diff: original (left) vs optimized (right). Changed lines highlighted. Per-line physics reason tooltip (chip thinning +15%, stability RPM shift, machine limit clamp). Aggregate summary card at top.
U-PH27.exit_gate: Diff shows changed S/F lines highlighted. Hover → physics reason. Summary shows cycle time delta, force reduction.

U-PH28.title: Build prove-out controls on page
U-PH28.description: Prove-out section: enable/disable toggle (default ON), feed% slider (default 50), speed% slider (default 80). When enabled, G-code preview shows derated values. Header comment updated. Promote to production button (disables prove-out).
U-PH28.exit_gate: Toggle ON → preview shows derated S/F + header warning. Slider adjustment updates in real-time. Promote button disables prove-out.

U-PH29.title: Fix Macor kc1.1 (1400→950), Mo kc1.1 (1800→1550), LB3000 RPM (3800→5000)
U-PH29.description: Correct 3 material constants and 1 machine spec in the CPS materialDatabase and machineDatabase. Also fix in the pipeline engine's physics constants if they exist there.
U-PH29.exit_gate: Macor kc1.1=950. Mo kc1.1=1550. LB3000 maxRpm=5000. Verified by grep.

U-PH30.title: Improve chip thinning formula with full (D-ae) term
U-PH30.description: Replace simplified 1/sqrt(ae/D) with full Sandvik formula: D/(2*sqrt(ae*(D-ae))). Keeps 50% WOC cutoff. Results in more accurate compensation at 15-40% WOC range.
abort_criteria: Formula produces NaN at ae=0 or ae=D
Results diverge >5% from old formula at <15% WOC
U-PH30.exit_gate: New formula matches Sandvik handbook. At 10% WOC: new=3.32x vs old=3.16x (5% closer to correct). At 25% WOC: new=2.31x vs old=2.0x (15% more accurate).

U-PH31.title: Add thin-wall derating mode
U-PH31.description: Add prismThinWallMode property (off/auto/manual). When wall thickness < 3xD, automatically reduce feed and DOC. Auto mode detects from Fusion's stock-to-leave and minimum radius. Show warning in G-code comment.
U-PH31.exit_gate: Thin-wall mode reduces feed 20-40% based on wall thickness. Auto-detects from Fusion data. Manual override available.

U-PH32.title: Fix MAZATROL detection + add version stamp to G-code header
U-PH32.description: MAZATROL detection now requires 2+ markers (not OR). Add PRISM version, material ID, physics model revision to every G-code header for AS9100 traceability.
U-PH32.exit_gate: MAZATROL needs 2+ markers. Header shows: PRISM v11, material ID, physics model date. Verified in test output.

U-PH33.title: Add DNC/drip-feed awareness for large programs
U-PH33.description: When program exceeds 5000 lines, add DNC warning comment in header. Add prismDNCMode property. When enabled, suppress optional stop, limit block length, add % at start/end for clean DNC operation.
U-PH33.exit_gate: Programs >5000 lines get DNC warning. DNC mode property available. Short programs unaffected.

U-PH34.title: Fix safe-start order + add extended work offsets
U-PH34.description: Change safe start to G90 G80 G40 G17 G21/G20 (G90 first). Add G54.1 P1-P48 support for extended work offsets beyond G59.
U-PH34.exit_gate: Safe start outputs G90 first. G54.1 P1-P48 available via workOffsetExtended property.

U-PH35.title: Add Hurco VMX30U + M88 TSC + Haas TSC option
U-PH35.description: Add VMX30U (5-axis trunnion) to machineDatabase. Fix M88 as through-spindle coolant code for Hurco. Add TSC pressure option for Haas machines (many have TSC installed as option, currently shows 0).
U-PH35.exit_gate: VMX30U in DB with correct 5-axis specs. M88 output for TSC when enabled. Haas TSC note in coolant property.

U-PH36.title: E2E test — Machine → Material → Tools → Generate flow
U-PH36.description: Comprehensive E2E test: search machine → select → controller auto-fills → features populate → search material → select → add tool → configure holder → select CAM → generate → verify CPS output. Test 3 machines (Haas VF-2, Hurco VM30i, DMG DMU 50).
abort_criteria: Any step in the flow fails
U-PH36.exit_gate: 3 E2E flows pass. Each produces valid CPS with correct machine/material/tool data embedded.

U-PH37.title: E2E test — All 8 CAM packages + offline fallback
U-PH37.description: Test post generation for each of 8 CAM packages. Verify output format differences. Test offline mode: disconnect server → page still works with embedded data → generation falls back to local.
abort_criteria: Any CAM package produces invalid output
U-PH37.exit_gate: 8 CAM packages produce valid output. Offline mode serves 200 materials + 160 machines. No crashes.

U-PH38.title: E2E test — Program upload + optimize + diff + prove-out
U-PH38.description: Upload real Haas NC program. Optimize with pipeline. Verify diff view shows changes with physics reasons. Toggle prove-out → verify derated values. Download optimized program.
U-PH38.exit_gate: Upload → optimize → diff → prove-out → download. All steps work. Physics reasons shown per line.

U-PH39.title: Re-run 20-agent scrutiny on fixed CPS
U-PH39.description: Launch all 20 scrutiny agents against the fixed CPS and web page. Collect findings. All CRITICAL and HIGH must be resolved.
U-PH39.exit_gate: 0 CRITICAL, 0 HIGH findings. All 20 agents report PASS or MINOR only.

U-PH40.title: Fix any remaining findings from re-scrutiny
U-PH40.description: Address any MEDIUM findings from the re-scrutiny that are practical to fix. Document remaining MINOR findings as known issues.
U-PH40.exit_gate: All practical MEDIUM fixes applied. Known issues documented.

U-PH41.title: Deploy final CPS + add-in to desktop
U-PH41.description: Copy final HURCO_VM30i_PRISM_v11.cps to desktop. Update add-in with fixed naming convention, CORS fix, manifest. Install to Fusion AddIns folder. Verify it loads.
U-PH41.exit_gate: CPS on desktop. Add-in installed and visible in Fusion. Panel opens. Server connection green.

U-PH42.title: Final regression — all PPG tests + MOAT + E2E
U-PH42.description: Run every PPG test file. Run MOAT regression. Run new E2E tests. All must pass. Omega >= 1.0.
U-PH42.exit_gate: All tests pass. 0 failures. Omega >= 1.0. Product ready.
